title: Canonical Internal Tool-Request Schema
description: ONE canonical internal tool-request schema for Gate 2-J.9T section G. Two input dialects normalize into this form.

tool.description: exactly one allowed tool name from the packet tool set

arguments.description: valid argument schema for the named tool

$comment: Normalization rules: native_openai_tool_calls normalize unchanged; strict textual JSON normalizes ONLY when it deterministically matches this envelope. Reject ambiguous pseudo-tool text.
x-textual-acceptance-requirements: strict JSON (no surrounding executable prose unless explicitly allowed)

x-handling-policies.duplicate_call_handling: one call per normalization pass, ordered
x-handling-policies.malformed_call_handling: reject plus bounded recovery feedback; never silent acceptance
x-handling-policies.multi_call_policy: execute one, reinject observation, next model turn
x-handling-policies.evidence: every parse decision recorded with parser name and status
x-handling-policies.model_feedback: truthful rejection under the expected role/tool name
